summary: Iter92 — Sprint A SEO Price Pages: full backend + frontend validation. All 15 pytest tests and 25 Playwright checks passed. Frontend /preturi index (14 cards, hero, CTA→/register, JSON-LD ItemList) and /preturi/:slug detail page (H1, 3 city tabs with live switch of table data + H1 city, Serviciu/UM/Standard/Expert columns, preliminar badges, disclaimer, CTA→/register, 4-item FAQ accordion, related chips navigate, FAQPage JSON-LD, 404 slug page, mobile 390x844 horizontally scrollable table, regression on /, /ghiduri, /marketplace all 200) all verified.

public.py sitemap: complex `is_with_city` logic for marketplace slugs is duplicated/overwritten (line 424 then 426); the first assignment is unused. Cosmetic cleanup.
price_seo.py: `related` list is deterministic (first 6 in PRICE_SEO order excluding current slug) — acceptable but consider randomizing or grouping by similarity for better UX.
test_credentials: N/A — all endpoints public, no auth required
seed_data_creation: None. Uses existing seeded price_observations (source=seed, ~132 rows: 22 services × 3 cities × 2 levels marked preliminar) — by design per problem statement.
